image_description: A male musician performing on a stage, holding an electric guitar. He is wearing a light blue striped shirt and beige trousers. A microphone stand is positioned in front of him. The background is dark with some visible stage rigging and faint text. The foreground shows the edge of the stage platform.

artifact_observations.location: Background, center-left, behind the microphone stand
artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint white text is visible in the background ('...octopus'?). The characters are slightly distorted and lack the crisp edges of real printed signage, suggesting AI-generated text artifacts.

The connection between the guitarist's left hand and the guitar neck is slightly ambiguous, with some blending of fingers into the fretboard. The guitar body shape is plausible but lacks precise mechanical definition around the pickups/bridge area.
The fabric folds on the shirt and pants appear slightly overly smooth and 'waxy' in certain areas, lacking the fine micro-texture of real cotton or denim, though this is subtle.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the hands and the guitar. AI often struggles with finger placement on instruments. Also, verify if the background text is meaningful or hallucinated gibberish, as this is a common artifact in concert scenes.
